'''Jostero''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Silestro Privateers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His headquarters was in the [[Rayless Lantern]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Pirate's Shadow]] belt.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

[[File:Captain_Jostero_GFH_Mariuz_Gandzel.png|thumb|left|250px|Captain Jostero piloting his personal Kihraxz assault starfighter]]
During the war, he challenged [[Tala (pilot)|Tala]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], to a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race. The privateers planned on killing Tala and her comrades and taking their belongings, no matter the outcome of the race. Tala won the race, but before the privateers could attack the trio, a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] belonging to the [[Corellian Security Force]] arrived and both parties involved in the race fled.<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

Later, Jostero tried to board a starship belonging to adventurers working for [[Gustip]], the [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] to the billionaire businessman and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Benton Kaldo]]. He used his ship the ''[[Bloodblade]]'', a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class]], and two [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighters]].<ref name="Suns of Fortune" />

Jostero also owned and piloted a [[Kihraxz assault fighter]] with a customized paint job.<ref name="GFH">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Captain Jostero}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Jostero was both aggressive and opportunistic in his business dealings.<ref name="SVCK">{{FFGXW2|set=Scum and Villainy Conversion Kit|cardname=Captain Jostero}}</ref>
